test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) She changed the angle and lighting in order to obtain the ideal snap.
(2) She opened her phone and scrolled through the icons to find the camera app.
(3) With a gentle touch on the screen, she took the photo successfully.
(4) Once it was opened, she kept the phone stable to see distinctly the object present in front.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage describes a sequence of actions taken to take a photo.
 
• The correct order of the sentences can be determined by following the logical flow of events:
 
 
• First, the person opens the phone and scrolls to find the camera app. This is Sentence 2.
 
• Next, after opening the app, they stabilize the phone to focus on the object. This is Sentence 4.
 
• Then, the person adjusts the angle and lighting to ensure the photo is ideal. This is Sentence 1.
 
• Finally, they take the photo successfully with a gentle touch. This is Sentence 3.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sequence of sentences is **2 - 4 - 1 - 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When arranging sentences, always look for logical and temporal order of events.
 
• Identify keywords or actions that indicate what happens first, next, and last.
 
• For example, in this case, opening the app (Sentence 2) must come first, and taking the photo (Sentence 3) must be the final step.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"She opened her phone and scrolled through the icons to find the camera app. Once it was opened, she kept the phone stable to see distinctly the object present in front. She changed the angle and lighting in order to obtain the ideal snap. With a gentle touch on the screen, she took the photo successfully."</div
